messages:
Zoe (marketing): Quick thread 4AC Need a tight battlecard + webinar blurb: focus on where Redwood wins vs cloud AI endpoints, LLM APIs, and appliance infra. Keep everything <1 sentence per bullet.
Hector (sales): Field leaderboard of objections: unpredictable bills, p99 latency spikes, migration lift, and 'we already have infra'. Want one-liners and demo hooks.
Maya (product): Proposed micro-structure for each objection: claim (1 line), why it matters (1 line), demo hook (1 line).
Ibrahim (eng): Bench note (short): internal chatbench shows ~2x median cost reduction on typical dialog flows vs a major managed endpoint when prefix caching + batching active. Caveat: region/prompt dependent, avoid p99 promises.
Zoe (marketing): Draft hero headlines (pick one):
 - "Serving economics, not model wars."
 - "Same models. Smarter serving. Lower bills."
Hector (sales): Rebut snippets (one-liners):
 - Obj: "We're on CloudX already."
   Reply: "For prototypes CloudX is great; in prod teams hit opaque tail costs. Redwood adds routing, caching and fallbacks so finance and SREs get predictable bills and SLOs."
 - Obj: "This will be a migration nightmare."
   Reply: "Most users start with our API as a drop-in and enable routing/caching incrementally; dedicated/private installs available for lift-and-shift migrations."
 - Obj: "On-prem gives us control."
   Reply: "We offer Private deployments and the same runtime + tooling so you keep control with unified observability."
Maya (product): Micro-technical line for SREs: "Continuous coalescing, per-session KV prefix reuse, and model-variant fallbacks lower repeat compute while preserving median latency."
Ibrahim (eng): Routing policy example for the demo slide:
```json
{"policy":"cost-first","primary":"redwood-llama-70b","fallbacks":["llama-13b-quant"],"kv_cache":true,"batch_target_ms":12}
```
Zoe (marketing): Inbound routing rules (short): keywords->AE: "SLA|on-prem|private|dedicated|compliance"; keywords->SDR: "trial|signup|api key|embed|free credits"; score>=80->AE,50-79->SDR, <50->mkt drip. Regex sample: `/\\b(SLA|on-?prem|private|dedicated|compliance)\\b/i`.
assets-bot: Created asset stub https://internal.redwood/marketing/assets/serve-econ-sprint (permissions: marketing-edit).
Hector (sales): I'll draft two roleplay lines for the battlecard after Zoe drops the one-pager.
Maya (product): I'll write the 1-paragraph benchmark blurb: "In controlled dialog workloads Redwood reduced median token spend ~2x vs a leading cloud endpoint by combining continuous batching, KV prefix caching, and model-variant fallbacks. We will demo a live routing scenario where traffic is automatically rerouted to a quantized variant under contention (internal lab results; customer results may vary)."
Zoe (marketing): Great. Aim to freeze copy by tomorrow noon so design can finish slides for the webinar. Post edits here. :sparkles:
